relations: If the leaning pink domino topples, it strikes the first upright tall domino.
Disturbing the upright row causes the tall dominoes to fall sequentially onto the base.
If the tall row collapses rightward, the line of small gray dominoes falls.
The scattered pile on the left persists unless further disturbance propagates through the standing row.
